ProducerSummary.description: Unchanged producer fields; exact integers outside JS safe range are decimal strings for size_bytes. No inferred intervals.

publishedJobs.description: Number of published attempt records, including retries of a machine/corpus job.

publishedCorpusJobs.description: Distinct machine/corpus pairs with at least one published completed attempt. Includes failed and unsupported outcomes; does not establish full session completion.

ResultSummaryData.description: Selected API summary. Exact producer values and identities are preserved; measurementMethodId resolves via /methods/{id}?definition=metricDefinitionId. The canonical result detail retains the complete method and evidence.

ReportAnalysisReferences.description: Original derived source JSON fields, excluding core typed transports and separately recorded analysis versions. Version source-fields-v1. Each reference resolves to ReportAnalysis or a chunked JSONResource for that envelope.
